# Sifely

The actions your AI can run on Sifely through DozalDevs. They are the same tools a Dozal uses, run the same way. Run one with `run_app_action` (MCP) or the run-app-action command, app `sifely` and the action's slug below; `get_app_action` shows its inputs. A Viewer key runs only the actions that read.

| Action                    | Reads or changes      | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `CREATE_PASSCODE`         | changes (access code) | Create a permanent passcode for a given Sifely lock                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `DELETE_PASSCODE`         | changes (access code) | Delete a passcode from a Sifely lock by passcode ID                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `DIAGNOSE_LOCKS`          | reads                 | Checks a list of Sifely locks for one named passcode: hub and whether it is online, battery, whether the passcode exists, whether the saved code is confirmed on the lock by the lock's own keypad log, its validity window, whether it matches the expected code, and recent keypad attempts, stating per door the plain fact of its keypad attempts in the window (times, or none). When a hub's status cannot be read, hub_online_unknown_reason says why. Changes nothing. |
| `GENERATE_CODE`           | reads                 | Generates a memorable 4–6 digit lock code using mirror (ABBA) or rhythm (ABAB) patterns, excluding weak or previously used codes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `GET_LOCK_STATE`          | reads                 | Read whether one Sifely smart lock is locked, with its battery and auto-lock setting                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `LIST_ACCESS_RECORDS`     | reads                 | List access records for a given Sifely lock within a date range                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `LIST_GATEWAYS`           | reads                 | List all Sifely gateways with online/offline status (isOnline: 0=offline, 1=online)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `LIST_LOCK_HUBS`          | reads                 | Says which hubs (Sifely gateways) each of a list of Sifely locks is paired to, with each hub name and whether it is online. A lock can have more than one hub. Changes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `LIST_LOCKS`              | reads                 | List all Sifely smart locks for the configured account                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `LIST_PASSCODES`          | reads                 | List all passcodes for a given Sifely lock                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `LIST_PASSCODES_ON_LOCKS` | reads                 | List all passcodes of several Sifely locks in one call                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `LOCK_LOCK`               | changes               | Lock one Sifely smart lock remotely through its hub and report its open state                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `SET_PASSCODE_ON_LOCKS`   | changes (access code) | Sets one named passcode to one code on a list of Sifely locks, all or nothing: if any lock cannot be changed, every lock touched is put back as it was.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `UNLOCK_LOCK`             | changes (access code) | Open one Sifely smart lock remotely through its hub                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `UPDATE_PASSCODE`         | changes (access code) | Update an existing passcode on a Sifely lock                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

## Notes

Written for Dozals, so an action is named by its slug in lowercase with dashes (`create-passcode` is `CREATE_PASSCODE`), and `--name` is the input `name`.

### Reading

- `list-locks` lists every lock on the account. `list-passcodes --lock-id` lists a lock's passcodes. `list-access-records --lock-id` shows keypad and unlock events; dates are epoch milliseconds, and it defaults to the last 7 days.
- `list-gateways` shows each hub and whether it's online (`isOnline` 0 is offline). `--offline-only` shows only the offline ones. `list-lock-hubs --lock-ids` shows which hubs each lock is paired to; a lock can have more than one, and you can ask about 1 to 20 locks at a time.
- `get-lock-state --lock-id` says whether one door is locked (`locked`, `unlocked` or `unknown`), with its battery, auto-lock seconds and passage mode. A lock with no hub cannot be asked, so its open state is `unknown` with a note.
- `diagnose-locks` checks locks for one named passcode and changes nothing. Give it `--lock-ids`, `--passcode-name`, and ideally `--expected-code`; the output says only whether the saved code matches. If a hub's status can't be read, the output says why. `keypad_facts` has one line per lock stating its keypad attempts in the `--hours` window (times in UTC and how many worked or failed, or that there were none): facts only, the Dozal draws the meaning.

### Changing codes

- Codes are 4 to 9 digits. `generate-code` makes a memorable 4 to 6 digit code (mirror like ABBA, or rhythm like ABAB) and skips any code in `--exclude-codes`. Pass the codes already used so you don't reuse one.
- `set-passcode-on-locks` sets one named passcode to one code on several locks, all or nothing. It needs `--lock-ids`, `--name`, `--code`, `--attempts` and `--wait-seconds`. Try `--dry-run` first: it checks every lock and changes none. `--replace-when-refused` removes and re-adds the passcode when a lock refuses every try.
- Creating, changing and deleting passcodes, setting codes, and `unlock-lock` all may wait for the owner's approval. `unlock-lock` opens a real door. Use it only when the job says to, on the lock it names. `lock-lock` locks a door through its hub, once per call, and then reports the open state it reads back; it is refused with nothing sent for a lock with no hub.
- Don't make many calls at once. Sifely refuses fast bulk traffic with a 429. Space calls out, and prefer the tools that take a list of locks.
- Never put a door code in a report that goes to a guest-facing channel unless the job says to.

### When it fails

- `Sifely authentication failed` means the saved username or password is wrong. Report it and stop.
- An HTTP 5xx is retried for you. A 4xx isn't. Read the message; it carries Sifely's own reason.
